name: Bang!
summary: Spaghetti Western hidden-role card game where Sheriff, Deputies, Outlaws and Renegade try to eliminate each other.
rules_text: 4-7 players get a secret role: Sheriff (public, +1 life), 0-2 Deputies, 2-3 Outlaws, 1 Renegade, plus a character with life points and a power. Shuffle role cards and deal one each, and deal character cards. Place draw deck in middle. Sheriff starts. On your turn: 1) Draw 2 cards. 2) Play any number of cards with limits: only 1 Bang! per turn unless character says otherwise, only 1 weapon in play, distance matters: you can only target players within weapon range counting seats, with +/- distance modifiers in play. Cards include Bang! to shoot, Missed! to cancel Bang!, Beer to heal 1. Blue bordered cards stay in play as equipment. 3) Discard to hand limit equal to current life. When hit, lose a life; at 0 you die, reveal role, leave game. If Sheriff kills Deputy he discards all cards. Game ends when Sheriff dies or all Outlaws and Renegades die. Winners: Sheriff+Deputies if Outlaws+Renegade dead, Outlaws if Sheriff dead, Renegade alone if last alive and Sheriff last to die before him.
rating_reason: Specific social deduction card game with hidden roles
